text: SWASHES定常流：非射流Bernoulli根 SWASHES steady flow: subcritical Bernoulli root SWASHES定常流：非射流Bernoulli根 q=4.42; h+z+q²/(2gh²)=2+q²/(8g); h>(q²/g)^(1/3). g9.81、[0,25]m、同じ放物線床、流量q4.42m²/s、下流h2m。h+z+q²/(2gh²)=2+q²/(8g)の非射流根を別の二分法で求め、セル平均求積を比較します。100/200/400セルのPDE計算は定常参照から初期化してt2まで進め、SWASHESの静止状態からの過渡計算そのものは再現しません。 SWASHES steady flow: subcritical Bernoulli root q=4.42; h+z+q²/(2gh²)=2+q²/(8g); h>(q²/g)^(1/3). Use g9.81,[0,25]m, the parabolic bed, discharge q4.42m²/s and downstream depth2m. Independently bisect the subcritical root of h+z+q²/(2gh²)=2+q²/(8g) and qualify cell quadrature.
